General Election - November 3rd, 2026The General Election is to elect people to Federal, State, and County offices. 
On Election Day, November 3, 2026, voters have to vote at their assigned polling location. Each polling place is open from 7 am to 8 pm. Polling locations, precinct maps and sample ballots are available online once ballots are approved.

General Election - November 5, 2024:
 When individuals hear the term "election", many often first think of the general election type. A General Election is the election in which federal and state officers, members of Congress and of the general assembly, county and township officers, and other officers appear on the ballot.
 

 

 On General Election Day, November 5, 2024, voters need to vote at their assigned polling
 place. Each polling location is open from 7 am to 8 pm. Polling locations, precinct maps and sample
 ballots are available online once ballots are approved. Check our Where to Vote page for more information.

Primary Election (City of Dubuque ONLY) - October 7, 2025:A Primary City Election is held when the number of candidates for an elected office is more than twice the number of seats to be filled. The two candidates that receive the most votes in the Primary City Election are nominated to appear on the Regular City Election ballot.

In 2025, the only municipality within Dubuque County with a Primary City Election is the City of Dubuque. Only registered voters who live in the City of Dubuque or respective Ward may vote in the October 7, 2025 City of Dubuque Primary Election. To find your Ward, visit our Elected Officials & Boundaries page.

City/School Election - November 4, 2025:
 Regular School and City Elections are combined. They are held countywide for school board members in each district, mayors and city council members (if any), and Northeast
 Iowa Community College Board of Trustees (if any).
 

 

 On Election Day, November 4, 2025, voters need to vote at their assigned polling
 place. Each polling location is open from 7 am to 8 pm. Polling locations, precinct maps and sample
 ballots are available online once ballots are approved. Check our Where to Vote page for more information.
